name: Kuroi Alice
source:
A mysterious girl that seems to know a lot more about what’s going on than the other main characters and appears to have an agenda of her own. She appears as a gothic Lolita type and does in fact go by the name Alice. 

[Edited from [url=http://theothersideofanime.blogspot.com/2014/03/forest-review-no-spoilers-here_24.html]The Other Side of Anime[/url]]
